KeyFactItem.description: One distinct value among the incident's flagged events, with the events it comes from.

event_count.description: Flagged events that carry the value.
event_count.title: Event Count

event_ids.description: The first of those events (at most 10), oldest first.
event_ids.title: Event Ids

first_seen.description: Time of the first of those events, UTC.
first_seen.title: First Seen

value.description: The value: an attack type, host, IP, port or user.
value.title: Value

KeyFactItem.title: KeyFactItem

description:
GET /incidents/{incident_id}/key-facts: computed by code, never by the model.

Only flagged events count (OD-02). Internal and external addresses follow response.toml
[network] (decision D3). Each list is ordered by first appearance, then value, and holds at
most 20 items; `truncated` says a list was cut.

last_flagged_at.description: Time of the latest flagged event, UTC.
last_flagged_at.title: Last Flagged At

network_config_version.description: response.toml config_version that split internal from external addresses.
network_config_version.title: Network Config Version

origin_ip.description: Source IP of the earliest flagged event when it is external; else null.
origin_ip.title: Origin Ip

started_at.description: Time of the earliest flagged event, UTC.
started_at.title: Started At

started_on.description: Host of the earliest flagged event, else its internal destination IP.
started_on.title: Started On

tactics.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactics ('TA0043 Reconnaissance') of those attack types, from the reviewed table tactics.toml; never chosen by the model. ATT&CK (c) MITRE.
tactics.title: Tactics

tactics_config_version.description: tactics.toml config_version that mapped attack types to ATT&CK tactics.
tactics_config_version.title: Tactics Config Version

truncated.description: True when a list held more than 20 values and was cut.
truncated.title: Truncated

title: IncidentKeyFacts
